authority.protocol_fingerprint: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 protocol file bytes, recorded in each future V2 run
authority.change_control: Discuss every proposed modification, update its design, obtain explicit user confirmation, and then execute only that design. Approved protocol changes require a new version.
authority.interpretation: A frozen decision does not mean the implementation or GPU environment has passed validation.

implementation_reference.framework_dependency_policy: Continue the project implementations. Anomalib v2.0.0 is a fixed algorithmic reference, not a package installation requirement.
implementation_reference.scope: Course configuration using ResNet18 and full-image 256x256 resizing; not a claim to reproduce original-paper best scores or every Anomalib implementation detail.

data.split_policy: Reuse the exact existing manifests; do not regenerate or resample their stored file lists.
data.nested_subsets: For each stored run seed: N20 is the first 20 of N50, and N50 the first 50 of N100.
data.mvtec_ad_dev: Existing approximately 20 percent normal holdout from train/good.
data.test_policy: Preserve all official test entries and masks listed in the manifests; no test-driven configuration or threshold selection.

preprocessing.mask_policy: Use original binary masks; if mask resizing is necessary, use nearest interpolation and binarize. Union all masks belonging to one anomalous image. Normal images have zero masks.

backbone.name: resnet18
backbone.weights_sha256_record: Determine and record the actual weight file hash in step 2 and in V2 cache metadata; do not invent it.

precision.metric_policy: Handle tied scores correctly. Ranking counts and metric accumulation may use integer or float64 accumulators for numerical accuracy.

randomness.dimension_selection: CPU seeded torch.randperm over concatenated channels, take the first d, then sort and save the selected indices.

padim.native_image_score: Maximum of the final 256x256 postprocessed anomaly map.

patchcore.memory_bank_size: min(M, max(1, round(coreset_ratio * M))) with Python round, where M is the full number of training patches.
patchcore.coreset_algorithm: Greedy k-center in the original feature space, with a seeded initial point; no dimensional projection; select distinct indices and record the sampling seed.
patchcore.random_comparison: Uniform sampling without replacement from exactly the same feature pool, retaining exactly the same number of points; use its output directly as the memory bank.
patchcore.patch_score: Euclidean distance to the single nearest memory-bank feature.

native_image_score.candidate: Select the image patch with the largest single-nearest-neighbor distance d_star.
native_image_score.reference_neighbor: The nearest memory-bank feature m_star to that selected test patch.
native_image_score.support: The 9 nearest memory-bank features to m_star, including m_star; cap the count at the bank size.
native_image_score.weight: 1 - softmax(distances from the selected test patch to the support features)[position_of_m_star]
native_image_score.separation: Compute independently of the postprocessed anomaly map; do not substitute its maximum or mean of nine test-to-bank distances.

patchcore.nearest_neighbor_execution: Chunked FP32 distance search; record chunk sizes and establish output equivalence for any approved execution adjustment.

anomaly_map.from_patch_scores: Bilinear resize to 256x256, align_corners=False, followed by fixed Gaussian smoothing.
anomaly_map.pixel_evaluation: Bilinear resize the final 256x256 continuous map to each original image size, align_corners=False; compare with the original binary mask.

image_scoring.map_rule_source: The same final postprocessed 256x256 continuous map.
image_scoring.top_q_formula: K=max(1,ceil(q*H*W)); take the arithmetic mean of the largest K pixel values.
image_scoring.pixel_invariance: Changing only the image aggregation rule must not change the anomaly map or any pixel metric.

metrics.ties: Group equal scores for threshold curves; give tied positive/negative pairs half credit for AUROC; AP must match grouped-threshold average precision.
metrics.normal_pixel_masks: Include normal test images with all-zero masks.
metrics.per_category_pixel_scope: All pixels at original resolution within that category.
metrics.main_macro: Equal weight across the six MVTec AD categories for each method, rule and seed.
metrics.three_seed_summary: Compute a six-category macro value per seed, then mean and sample standard deviation across seeds 17,29,43; use ddof=1.
metrics.single_seed_scans: Report individual results as exploratory, without invented standard deviations.
metrics.loco_macro_policy: Keep separate from the six-category MVTec AD macro.
metrics.aupro: Optional; not required or implemented by step 1.

offline_stages.first_checkpoint: Evaluate seed 17 after the 22 core fits; extend when R0 results are ready.

execution.formal_compute: CCDS GPU Cluster TC2 GPU compute nodes via sbatch.
execution.cpu_role: Local metric verification, aggregation and plotting; record any CPU metric stage separately.
execution.head_node_role: Account/resource queries, file management and job submission; no experiments or GPU probes.
execution.allocation_policy: Use only the actual account-authorized partition, QoS and resources verified in step 2; do not treat guide examples as current allocations.
execution.cuda_device_policy: Honor SLURM-assigned visible devices; a requested formal GPU run must fail clearly if CUDA is unavailable.
execution.cache_dependency: Step 2 prepares environment, raw data and weights and audits old caches. Step 5 implements V2 cache support. Step 6 generates and validates FP32 caches for the pilot; subsequent extraction uses that validated path.
execution.legacy_cache_policy: Existing FP16 caches are historical inputs and do not meet the V2 FP32 storage contract.
execution.timing_policy: Separate feature extraction, fit, prediction and evaluation; document all included I/O and preprocessing; compare like GPU models with the same protocol, batch=1, 20 warmups and CUDA synchronization.
execution.evidence_policy: Record actual software/driver/hardware versions, effective configuration, protocol hash, manifest hash, split hash, weight hash, seeds, stage timings, memory scope and SLURM job ID; never infer current GPU details from guide screenshots.

outputs.path_base: group_XX_code project directory, resolved at runtime without a personal absolute home path.
outputs.consistency: Write metrics and saved scores from the same arrays. Verify counts, path order, labels, finite values and metric reproducibility before SUCCESS.
outputs.skip_policy: Only skip a validated V2 run matching protocol, effective configuration and input fingerprints; legacy SUCCESS markers never qualify.

validation: Verify all pre-existing protected file hashes
Verify only the four approved paths changed
step_1_scope.deferred_work: GPU access, environment changes, dataset downloads, model/metric/source-code changes, V2 directory activation, cache extraction and experimental runs belong to their separately approved later steps.
